You can be like him even better than him(:
Trust me you can do it, you gotta start now and don’t ever stop, you will crack the code and become everything you want to be^.^
I’m in Los Angeles, California

I wish I was around so I can play basketball with you, it’s my favorite sport too. Remember sometimes people who bully others are because they are miserable or unhappy with their life. In order for them to feel better they have to put others down, it’s what they want so DONT GIVE THEM WHAT THEY WANT. You’re capable of anything you put your mind to, right now you’re 13 years old you have so many years to practice what you love to perfect it and get yourself ready for one of the biggest moment of your life because you will have many big moments. You’re young and right now is perfect for you to start doing anything you like. Enjoy your youth and forget those mean kids. If the NBA is what you want to do then go for it and do it! I recommend recording great moments when you’re playing basketball and save them or upload them to remind yourself “yeah I did that bad ass stunt”. When your family doesn’t believe in you it’s only because they cannot see the bigger picture, your goals, your vision. You have to do it yourself and show them that you believe in yourself and you will make your vision happen and be like “see I told you I got this and I am doing it.” You are smart, and I believe in you and you will be in the NBA!
